name: apt-cacher-ultra
description: Caching proxy for Debian and Ubuntu package downloads (apt). The first machine that installs a package fetches it from the internet; every other machine gets it from your server. A maintained replacement for apt-cacher-ng: same port 3142 and the same client settings, so existing clients keep working. Checks every file against the repository's signed index, and keeps serving cached packages when a mirror is slow or down. Clients: put Acquire::http::Proxy "http://SERVER-IP:3142"; into /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/01proxy. HTTPS repositories are not cached unless their sources line is changed to http://HTTPS///host/path. The config is written to /config/config.toml on the first start; edit it there and restart. The status page and Prometheus metrics are on port 6789.

paths.name: Cache
paths.description: Downloaded packages and the cache database. A cache pool is faster than the array.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: config.toml, written with defaults on the first start.

ports.name: Proxy port
ports.description: Port the apt clients use: Acquire::http::Proxy "http://SERVER-IP:3142";

ports.name: Status page port
ports.description: Status page, /metrics (Prometheus) and /healthz. Set an admin password below if other people can reach it.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Optional. Protects the status page with a login (user below). Empty = no login.

variables.name: Admin user
variables.description: Login name for the status page when a password is set.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns the cache files.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns the cache files.

variables.name: Time zone
variables.description: Time zone for log timestamps, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
